# Old Basement PC assets

The bundled theme source is `src/themes/old-basement-pc.json`. It embeds the font and wallpaper so exports work offline.

IBM Plex Mono Latin regular comes from `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono` 5.3.0, unmodified, under SIL OFL 1.1. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Its normal UI sizes replace the larger sizes needed by the previous pixel font. Editor body text is 19px; nested outline text stays at 14px.

The original [midnight cloud wallpaper](assets/midnight-clouds.webp) was generated with the built-in image generation tool, then encoded as WebP for the theme. It is used only behind the panels. Theme styling and original artwork are supplied under CC0.

Generation prompt:

> Deep muted midnight/navy blue sky with a few very soft wispy slate-blue clouds drifting across it, nostalgic early Windows desktop mood but original artwork. Restrained low contrast, dark enough to sit quietly behind solid navy application windows; subtle cloud detail visible near all edges. Full bleed sky only, no land, no hills, no sun, no stars, no text, no logos, no interface. Smooth clean photographic cloud texture, no grain or pixel noise. Overall dark blue, never bright cyan or white. Landscape 1536x1024.

## Light-mode wallpaper

[Daylight meadow](assets/daylight-meadow.webp) is original artwork generated with the built-in image generation tool, then encoded as WebP. It is bundled under the same CC0 artwork terms and appears only behind the panels in light mode.

Generation prompt:

> An original landscape desktop wallpaper for a nostalgic Windows-style notes app. A calm blue daytime sky with soft fluffy white clouds and a simple rolling green meadow along the lower quarter. Fresh medium sky blue, natural green grass, gentle sunlight, clean smooth photographic rendering. Clouds distributed across the edges as well as the center to remain visible through narrow gaps between panels. Original composition, not an exact reproduction of any existing wallpaper. No people, buildings, trees, roads, mountains, logos, text, watermark, or interface. Avoid dramatic HDR, neon colors, grain, and stormy skies. Pleasant and quiet behind opaque white and gray windows. Landscape 1536x1024.
